Gateway.//ServerCertificate: PKCS#12 (.pfx) the gateway presents. If omitted, a self-signed DEV cert (localhost) is generated.
Gateway.//ClientTrust: Device certs are validated against THIS CA only (custom root trust). Source order: Key Vault certificate, then inline PEM, then file path.
Gateway.//CaCertificateKeyVault: PRODUCTION: read the SCEP CA public cert from a Key Vault SECRET (PEM value) via the managed identity. Set both Uri + Name (the secret name).
Gateway.//CaCertificateFallbacks: Local/dev only — used when no Key Vault source is set.
Gateway.//AllowAnyClientCertificate: DEV ONLY - disables chain validation. Leave false in production.
Gateway.//Sink: file = NDJSON under LandingDirectory (dev); warehouse = Azure SQL (prod).
Gateway.//ConnectionString: Required when Sink=warehouse. Secret-free Entra auth.
